## Change

What behavior or capability does this add? Link the task and name any changed contract.

## Grounding

Which claims are supported by proofs, types, tests, monitoring or an upstream
contract? State relevant assumptions and limits. A dependency's implementation
does not need to be re-proved here.

## Verification

Record the commands and results, including `mix check`, plus any integration
environment required. Identify remaining work without calling it implemented.
